description: World Rugby men's 15s world rankings from World Rugby's official rankings API: position, team, country code, rating points, and previous position and points, from the current table (World Rugby recalculates it after international matches). limit returns the top N teams (1 to 100, default 20); there is no team filter, so read the team you need from the list. Men's 15s only, no women's or sevens tables. For national football teams use search_fifa_team_rankings. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.
